  exact ⟨⟨_, Or.inl hsrc.1, hsrc.2⟩, ⟨_, Or.inl hdst.1, hdst.2⟩⟩

    history := v.history ++ [newHistory],

    r.invariant → r.hasVariable name = false → ∀ r', r.createVariable name val t = some r' → r'.invariant := by
  intro hinv hnovar r' hcreate
  simp [ZRuntime.createVariable, hnovar] at hcreate
  subst hcreate
  simp [ZRuntime.invariant] at *
  intro n1 n2 hn1 hn2 heq

  simp [ZRuntime.historyMonotonic, List.length_append]

def ZRuntime.createVariable (r : ZRuntime) (name : String) (initial_value : Option String) (timestamp : Int) : Option ZRuntime :=
  if r.hasVariable name then none else
    let newVar : ZVariable :=
      match initial_value with
      | some val => (ZVariable.empty name).assign val timestamp
      | none => ZVariable.empty name
    let newHistory : ExecutionHistoryEntry :=
      { action := .create_variable, primary_target := name, secondary_targets := [],
        operation_type := none, result_value := initial_value, result_int := none,
        result_float := none, timestamp := timestamp, allocator := r.allocator }
    some { r with
      variables := r.variables ++ [(name, newVar)],
      execution_history := r.execution_history ++ [newHistory] }

        operation_type := none, result_value := none, result_int := none,
        result_float := none, timestamp := timestamp, allocator := r.allocator }
    ({ r with
      variables := r.variables.filter (fun p => p.1 ≠ name),
      execution_history := r.execution_history ++ [newHistory] }, true)

def ZVariable.relateTo (self : Box ZVariable) (other : Box ZVariable) (relationship_type : EdgeQuality) :
    Except String Unit :=
  do
    let self_val := self.get
    let other_val := other.get
    when self_val.graph.get.nodeCount = 0 || other_val.graph.get.nodeCount = 0 do
      pure ()
    let self_node_id ← getLatestNodeId self
    let other_node_id ← getLatestNodeId other
    let self_qubit ←
      match self_val.graph.get.getQuantumState self_node_id with
      | some q => pure q
      | none => pure (Qubit.initBasis0.a)
    let other_qubit ←
      match other_val.graph.get.getQuantumState other_node_id with
      | some q => pure q
      | none => pure (Qubit.initBasis0.a)
    let other_conj := other_qubit.conjugate
    let correlation := self_qubit.mul other_conj
    let weight := correlation.magnitude
    let fractal_dim : Float := 0.0
    when self_val.graph.get.getNodeConst other_node_id = none do
      match other_val.graph.get.getNodeConst other_node_id with
      | some other_node =>
        let cloned ← other_node.clone self_val.allocator
        let _ ← self_val.graph.get.addNode cloned
      | none => pure ()
    let edge := edgeInitCompat self_val.allocator self_node_id other_node_id relationship_type weight correlation fractal_dim
    let _ ← self_val.graph.get.addEdge self_node_id other_node_id edge
    let buf : Array UInt8 := #[]
    let relate_str := "relate"
    let history_entry ← HistoryEntry.init self_val.allocator HistoryEntryType.relate relate_str
    let _ ← self_val.history.append history_entry
    pure ()

  do
    let self_val := self.get
    when self_val.logic.get.stateCount > 0 do
      let indices := #[self_val.logic.get.stateCount - 1]
      let _ ← self_val.logic.get.applyGate gate indices params
    let history_entry ← HistoryEntry.init self_val.allocator HistoryEntryType.transform (gate.toString)
    let _ ← self_val.history.append history_entry
    pure ()

def ZVariable.measure (self : Box ZVariable) : MeasurementResult :=
  let self_val := self.get
  if self_val.logic.get.stateCount > 0 then
    let result := self_val.logic.get.measure (self_val.logic.get.stateCount - 1)
    let buf : Array UInt8 := #[]
    let measure_str := "measure"
    let _ ←
      match HistoryEntry.init self_val.allocator HistoryEntryType.measure measure_str with
      | Ok history_entry =>
        match self_val.history.append history_entry with
        | Ok _ => pure ()
        | Error _ =>
          history_entry.deinit
          pure ()
      | Error _ => pure ()
    result
  else
    { result := 0, probability := 0.0, collapsed_state := QuantumState.init 1.0 0.0 0.0 0.0 }
